treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Canada and the Government of the Kingdom of Denmark for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (1997, with Protocol)
eif_quote: [CTS 1998/16] Entry into Force 02 March 1998 | Justice Laws I-3.52: [Note: Convention in force March 2, 1998, see Canada Gazette Part I, Volume 132, page 783.] | Art. 31(2)(a): (a) in respect of tax withheld at the source on amounts paid or credited to non-residents on or after 1st January in the calendar year next following that in which the Convention enters into force; and
source_title: Canada Treaty Information (GAC): Canada-Denmark Convention 1997 (E102422); Protocol in Income Tax Conventions Implementation Act, 1997, Schedule 5

rates.quote: (a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
(c) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude; having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: MLI Art. 8 applies: Canada (no. 19, Art. 10(2)(a)) and Denmark (no. 9, Art. 10(2)) both notified; from 2020-01-01 the 25% holding must be met throughout a 365-day period. Not modelled: Art. 10(2)(b) 10% for dividends paid by a Canadian non-resident-owned investment corporation to a Danish holder of >=25% ("(b) notwithstanding the provisions of subparagraph a), 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the dividends are paid by a nonresident owned investment corporation that is a resident of Canada to a beneficial owner that is a resident of Denmark and that holds directly or indirectly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends; and"); Art. 30(3) dividends to exempt pension organisations exempt. Art. 11(3)-(4): late-payment, central-bank, unrelated credit-sale, pension-plan, government-debt and EDC/Eksportkreditraadet interest taxable only in residence State. Art. 12(3): copyright (excl. film/TV), computer software, patent and know-how royalties (excl. rental/franchise) taxable only in residence State. Art. 10(6) branch tax max 5%. Protocol at signature concerns shipping and Greenland only.
